narr: The remnants of Debby tracked through the area Thursday night into Friday, August 8th into August 9th. Tropical moisture combined with lift from the remnants to cause heavy rain across much of Virginia. The heavy rain led to several instances of flash flooding and flooding.
ev: Warehime Road was closed due to flooding near Grave Run Creek.
Hollingsworth Road closed between Glen Falls Road and Buttonwood Court due to flooding.
County Emergency Manager reported that Hoffman Mill Road is closed between Paper Mill Drive and Hattie Drive.
County Emergency Manager reported flooding with flowing water on Twin Arch Road near the Caroll and Howard County line.
A vehicle was stranded in high water along the 12,000 Block of Game Preserve Road. The road was closed due to flooding.
The 26200 Block of Long Corner Road was closed due to flooding, possibly undermining the road at Scott Branch.
North Creek was flooding over Wightman Road.
A vehicle was trapped in high water on MD-193 University Boulevard East at MD-650 New Hampshire Avenue. The roadway was blocked by high water.
The Emergency Manager reported that a water rescue occurred along the Francis Scott Key Highway near North Stone Road.
